line: The Chapter wants to see how you work. I do not know you yet, so I say it short.
Keeps-What-Floats took a necklace of blue jaspers from another thief who was asleep. Bring it back. Do not harm him.
He carries it on his round of the dock. Follow him. Sits-By-The-Water drinks with him.

He lives. You have good hands. Here are one hundred gold and three lockpicks.
The Chapter's way down is a locked trapdoor at the edge of the deep water north of Pusbottom in Lilmoth.
Take the coast ship from this dock. Open the trapdoor with your own hand. Speak to whoever waits below.
